description: CLK1 (2m, the wanted signal is the fundamental) through a home-built 9-pole Chebyshev low-pass filter (163 MHz cutoff) and a measured 37 dB pad set

chain.name: 9-pole Chebyshev low-pass
chain.notes: designed cutoff 163 MHz, measured -3 dB point 173 MHz; replaces both cheap filters (200 MHz low-pass and 137M/140M band-pass); screening not recorded

chain.name: pad set
chain.notes: measured, not the labels: the 27-33-27 ohm T pad (15 dB) in series with the BNC attenuator marked 10 dB (really 27 dB), joined with SMA/BNC adapters. Measured together without a filter on 2026-10-31 as 37.4 dB at 145 MHz (36.9 to 38.4 dB from 20 to 180 MHz).

notes: Compare with the other 2m runs in tests-results/2m. Same pad set, so levels are comparable. The pad value was measured without any filter in front of it. The response test only covers up to 200 MHz; harmonics are seen in the wide spectrum test.
